prompt:

The dark silver contact and bright gold contact must contrast.
BOTTOM ROW: broken dark electronic plastic enclosure with clear material label "> ABS-FR <" and "brominated". Nearby element card "Br" "-1" and text "Group 17", "7 valence e-", "common ion -1". No people, hands, logos, watermarks, or invented text. Faithfully copy evidence from the reference but make physical objects and printed notes photorealistic.
